messages:
margo: Heads-up — after the terraform PR that bumped ES_MAX_WORKERS the external-secrets controller started showing backpressure and slow secret propagation across a few namespaces last night. noticed a lot of requeues and OOMKills. anyone else see this?
jesse: I saw contention in the syncer queue metric spikes. Which env did you hit? prod or staging?
tay: :eyes: can you paste pod logs + kubectl top? I'll check node pressure.
margo: prod. logs excerpt: ```E 03:12:11 controller sync error: rate limit exceeded, requeue after backoff
I 03:12:12 syncing secret default/db-credentials -> requeue
Kubernetes pod went OOMKilled: container "controller" exceeded memory limit```
margo: kubectl top (trimmed): ```NAME                                CPU(cores)   MEMORY(bytes)
external-secrets-controller-0        920m         1.7Gi
external-secrets-controller-1        810m         1.6Gi
```
jesse: terraform change was in infra-secrets module — we bumped ES_MAX_WORKERS from 20 -> 40 and removed limits in the same change. link to PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/2345
vikram: also correlating with Vault 429s in audit logs around same timestamp. looks like controller parallelism pushed Vault rate limit and then controller retried heavily -> queue backlog.
margo: good call. we didn't account for upstream rate limits. what are quick remediation options? rollback terraform? throttling/circuit-breaker?
jesse: short-term: revert the worker bump in terraform and re-add sane resource limits on the controller deployment. medium: add a client-side rate limiter and backoff config in the external-secrets chart, and document Vault token QPS.
tay: propose immediate helm patch to set replicas:2 and resources: requests 200m/256Mi, limits 1000m/2Gi, and set env ES_MAX_WORKERS=16. snippet: ```kubectl -n redwood patch deployment external-secrets-controller --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":2}}'
# or helm upgrade with values: externalSecrets:
#   controller:
#     replicaCount: 2
#     resources:
#       requests:
#         cpu: 200m
#         memory: 256Mi
#       limits:
#         cpu: 1000m
#         memory: 2Gi
#     env:
#       - name: ES_MAX_WORKERS
#         value: "16"'```
margo: I'll open a rollback PR for the terraform change and also a patch PR to the chart. pinging oncall in case we need faster rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy requested by margo for rollbacks/infra-secrets (dry-run queued) :white_check_mark:
vikram: I'll throttle Vault clients for the controller via Vault proxy rate limit as a safety net. curl to check: `curl -s http://vault-host:8200/v1/sys/metrics` shows bursts of 429s at 03:12 UTC.
jesse: once PRs are up, please @me. also will add a short blameless postmortem note in the infra channel — this is a config/assumptions gap.
tay: monitoring plan: add alert on external-secrets queue length > 50 and Vault 429 rate > 5/min, and run a scheduled stress test in staging with the new worker count before applying to prod.
margo: PRs: rollback terraform: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/2350  chart patch: https://git.internal/r/redwood/charts/+/780  (both open, tests passing). tagging for review @jesse @vikram.
jesse: quick review done, left one comment about updating docs for Vault QPS limits. :thumbsup:
margo: thanks — will merge the rollback first, then apply chart patch once nodes stabilize.
tay: sounds good. I'll keep an eye on nodes and provide status updates here. :partyparrot:
